reviews.text: I treated myself to a facial here today and had such a wonderful experience! From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly warm and inviting. The salon has a cozy atmosphere and a really cute boutique that adds to the charm. Most importantly, the facial was affordable and absolutely worth it—I’m already glowing! I’ve already rebooked for next month. Highly recommend!

My husband and I both went to get haircuts. He got Lisa she was gentle took her time gave him a great haircut. He has medium curly/straight hair and his curls look great afterwards. I had Carmen and omg when she washed my hair it was the best scalp massage ever. Gave me the most beautiful layers and styled my hair amazingly.
The experience with Nancy was amazing. Got a perm and a cut and it looks great! Will be coming back soon to get it retouch.
